maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is from LTL freight transportation shipping services, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed customer assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private shippers, such as retailers, grocers and manufacturers, paying for LTL freight shipping.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows organically by adding terminals, doors, trailers and drivers to its LTL network; it is not an acquisition roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: LTL freight is a fairly standardized service; shippers can use other carriers, though the site calls it mission-critical.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call; LTL carriers can be swapped with moderate effort.
